description:
ImagePolicySpec defines the parameters for calculating the
ImagePolicy.

digestReflectionPolicy.description:
DigestReflectionPolicy governs the setting of the `.status.latestRef.digest` field.

Never: The digest field will always be set to the empty string.

IfNotPresent: The digest field will be set to the digest of the elected
latest image if the field is empty and the image did not change.

Always: The digest field will always be set to the digest of the elected
latest image.

Default: Never.

enabled.description: Whether to render this resource. Defaults to true.

filterTags.description:
FilterTags enables filtering for only a subset of tags based on a set of
rules. If no rules are provided, all the tags from the repository will be
ordered and compared.

extract.description:
Extract allows a capture group to be extracted from the specified regular
expression pattern, useful before tag evaluation.

pattern.description:
Pattern specifies a regular expression pattern used to filter for image
tags.

fullNameOverride.description: Replaces the entire computed resource name, ignoring the release name and id.

imageRepositoryRef.description:
ImageRepositoryRef points at the object specifying the image
being scanned

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent, when not specified it acts as LocalObjectReference.

interval.description:
Interval is the length of time to wait between
refreshing the digest of the latest tag when the
reflection policy is set to "Always".

Defaults to 10m.

nameOverride.description: Replaces just the id part of the computed resource name (<Release.Name>-<id>).

namespace.description: metadata.namespace for this resource. Defaults to the release namespace.

policy.description:
Policy gives the particulars of the policy to be followed in
selecting the most recent image

alphabetical.description: Alphabetical set of rules to use for alphabetical ordering of the tags.

order.description:
Order specifies the sorting order of the tags. Given the letters of the
alphabet as tags, ascending order would select Z, and descending order
would select A.

numerical.description: Numerical set of rules to use for numerical ordering of the tags.

order.description:
Order specifies the sorting order of the tags. Given the integer values
from 0 to 9 as tags, ascending order would select 9, and descending order
would select 0.

semver.description:
SemVer gives a semantic version range to check against the tags
available.

range.description:
Range gives a semver range for the image tag; the highest
version within the range that's a tag yields the latest image.

suspend.description:
This flag tells the controller to suspend subsequent policy reconciliations.
It does not apply to already started reconciliations. Defaults to false.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: spec.interval is only accepted when spec.digestReflectionPolicy is set to 'Always'
spec.interval must be set when spec.digestReflectionPolicy is set to 'Always'
